title: Swat Museum
subtitle: Gandhara collection on the Mingora-Saidu Sharif road, Lower Swat
edits: A bench up to 24 m wide is cut along the road to its smoothed profile (the 30 m DSM includes tree canopy).
Road bumps and ruts in the drive are illustrative; the grade and the line of the road are real.
Trees, shrubs, grass tufts and boulders are placed where WorldCover maps that cover; their size and number are illustrative.
The walking loop is a 40 m circle around the arrival point; it is not a mapped trail.

The footprint is the OSM outline of way 450094924 (tourism=museum, name 'ajaeb ghar'), about 9,700 m2 and about 95 m east-west by 144 m north-south, which is larger than the building in the photos. It is used only to place the museum: the place point 34.7635, 72.35922 lies inside it and the node 'Swat Museum' (4447626923) lies 0.1 m from the point. The OSM outline has no height and is not drawn as a building.

The building is drawn after Commons photos 04 and 05 (proportions, portal, columns, colours, steps, garden): a 22 m by 12 m stone block, 8 m high to the coping, with a 9 m portal and two 5 m columns. These sizes are estimated from the photos; nothing published gives them.

The cladding is warm buff-pink banded sandstone, the portal surround blue-grey, the columns grey-white, the gates dark, the lawn dry and yellow-green; the green lattice wings are simplified to solid screens. The name over the portal is lettered in the photos; the model leaves that band blank.
The front faces the road, which runs 42 m west of the point. The facade orientation is estimated from the drive end.

The dry lawn, the concrete path, the dwarf hedges, the two rounded shrubs (drawn as cones, not palms), the carved stone on a plinth and the signboard are placed after the photos; their positions are estimated.
The 2,487 OSM buildings stand on their footprints; their height (OSM levels where mapped, else one or two storeys), roofs and colours are illustrative, after visitors' photos.
The Atlas TRELLIS model from one photo is no longer used: it read as a dark box and did not match the photos.
The 2487 buildings stand on their OSM footprints; their height (OSM levels where mapped, else one or two storeys), roofs and colours are illustrative, after visitors' photos.
Season colours, snow, ice and dawn mist are illustrative.

Traffic on the drive is illustrative: the vehicle kinds are those seen on Swat roads (Willys jeeps, Hilux, Suzuki vans, Mehran cars, CD70 motorbikes, Qingqi rickshaws, painted trucks); their number and movement are not counted.
